text:
sam: deploybot paused release build-427 — preflight found env parity for secret mounts + s3 presign mismatch, holding.
maya: what checks failed?
deploybot: [deploycheck] blocked release: 3 failures
```
- initContainer secret mount: staging -> hostPath symlink (/etc/secret-link), prod -> projected volume (secretName embed-cache)
- helm values: .values.embed.cacheSecretName = "embed_cache" (staging) vs "embed-cache" (prod)
- s3 client presign config: staging uses signatureVersion='v4', prod uses legacy presign (v2) -> backend denies getObject
```
theo: ugh, that explains 403s hitting embedding cache in prod canary.
rachel: do we rollback? this was a config-only change, right?
sam: yes, only helm values and an init container script changed. safe to patch.
lina: current release window closes in 40m. we can push a quick patch if small.
theo: suggest two-step: pin model-serving to embed-model:v2.1.0 so canary uses old artifact while we fix helm values; then patch and re-run deploycheck.
sam: agree. patch plan:
- change values.embed.cacheSecretName to match prod canonical "embed-cache"
- remove hostPath symlink usage in initContainer and use projected secret volume
- ensure S3 client picks sig v4 (env var S3_SIGNATURE_VERSION= 's3v4' in values)
deploybot: approved workflow: create patch branch -> update chart -> push -> deploycheck -> if passes, promote canary -> schedule full rollout
maya: I'll open PR and tag @theo @rachel for review. PR id: #4832
rachel: can someone validate the secret casing across k8s clusters? I can run a grep across manifests.
theo: I'll run a quick smoke against staging after PR. if deploycheck still fails we rollback to last stable image: embed-model:v2.0.7
sam: OK hold on release. deploying patch will be timeboxed to the current window. ping here when deploycheck passes.
devops-bot: deploy-window: 2026-03-21 15:00-16:00 UTC — emergency patches permitted
maya: PR opened: https://git.redwood/infra/charts/4832 — updating values + env. tagging reviewers.
sam: thanks. assigning rollback owner: @rachel if canary fails.
